tickets.title: Kotlin contracts and the conformance harness: :testing fixture walker, canonical JSON, strict session decoding, pct, units and record round-trips
tickets.what_to_build: The :core twin of iOS T03. :testing resolves the repository root from the `jovra.repoRoot` system property with `inputs.dir("../spec")` declared on every JVM test task, walks spec/fixtures, spec/studio/fixtures and spec/room/fixtures in place (never copied), and keeps one marker file per fixture kind under android/testing/conformance-kinds/<kind>.consumed|.pending; a kind with no marker fails the run (mirrors scripts/spec/validate.py), a `.consumed` kind with no registered runner fails, and an unconsumed fixture file under a consumed kind fails. Spec tickets that add a kind add a `.pending` marker; the Android ticket that ports the kind flips it. It also provides a canonical JSON comparator (deep equality, integers only) and a FakeMonotonicClock. :core gains the canonical JSON writer (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8, integers as integers, refuses floats where the contract does), strict kotlinx.serialization decoding (unknown keys rejected, integral floats like 744.0 refused for integers, ids checked with ECMA-262 end-of-input semantics), the session document model for every field in spec/schemas (decodes jon-vs-alex.session.json), `pct(n, d) = (200n + d) / (2d)` in Long arithmetic with d = 0 → null, units in BigDecimal (≥ 20 digits, half-up once) for convert/display/gaugeHint, the capability registry reader with provenance labels, and record round-trips for equipment, practice plan and the capability registry. A source test fails if DecimalFormat, NumberFormat.getPercentInstance or roundToInt appear under :core. It also records the cross-DAG choice for markers: they stay a required android-core rule, so before this PR merges amendment issues are filed on T13, T31, T32, T52, S05-S09, S55 and S56 (each adds a `.pending` marker in the PR that adds its kind), and `.github/CODEOWNERS` routes android/testing/conformance-kinds/ to the Android owner.
